method: Built-in image_gen; original illustrated bitmap assets. Mechanical browser-canvas export to 320px-wide WebP, quality 0.72. Titles and spines are separately typeset by the game.
artDirection: Fictional 1990s game packaging, restrained hand-painted gouache/airbrush, cohesive printed colours, no text, logos, real brands or existing characters. Low-resolution in-game printing rather than glossy modern key art.

assets.prompt: Original late-1990s kart-racing box illustration: red-helmeted driver, two rivals, rolling hills. Repaint with broad gouache and airbrush shapes, restrained 1997 printed palette, no lettering or logos, not glossy modern CGI.

Original fictional Goldenballs spy-game illustration: dinner-jacket agent with binoculars, navy and gold target/radar motifs and mountains. Hand-painted 1990s adventure packaging, no real actor likeness, guns, lettering or logos.

Original Warp Wombat platform-game packaging illustration: stocky round-eared brown wombat in teal waistcoat, jungle bridge and crate, warm hand-painted 1990s palette. No existing mascot likeness, lettering or logos.
